title: Levi HaSard or HaSadr, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the [Mekhilta at the beginning of Parashat Ki Tisa](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Shabbata.1.3) and in [Yoma 85a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.85a.13): that Rabbi Yishmael, Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah were walking along the road, while Levi HaSered and Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah, were walking behind them. And the Arukh explains that he made 'bigdei serad' (woven/service garments).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Yoma has HaSadar, while the linked Mekhilta Hebrew gives HaSarad and glosses it as a maker of service garments. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2328&lang=en) reports a garment or implement maker in his quotation from the Arukh.
